backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining all backend types (UserProfile, Video, CarMeet, DirectMessage, BuildLog, etc.) and including authorization and blob-storage mixins for the RevReel platform.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping three landing page features (route setup, router config, and hero section design) to their implementing files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-sentence summaries of each frontend source file, serving as a reference index for the project's frontend components, pages, and hooks.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base stylesheet defining OKLCH CSS custom property color tokens for both light and dark themes used throughout the app.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point that mounts the React app into a root div and loads the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: TanStack Router configuration that places the landing page at '/' without a Layout shell and nests all authenticated app routes (feed, profile, upload, etc.) under a shared layout wrapper route.
frontend/src/components/AuthGuard.tsx: Component that blocks unauthenticated access by showing a neon-styled login prompt with an Internet Identity button, and renders children only when the user is authenticated.
frontend/src/components/CarMeetCard.tsx: Renders a card for a car meet event showing title, organizer, date, location, attendee count, and category badge, with attend/leave button logic and authentication gating.
frontend/src/components/ChallengeModal.t: Modal dialog that lets an authenticated user select one of their own videos to challenge another user's video, then submits the challenge via a mutation.
frontend/src/components/CommentsPanel.ts: Slide-in panel displaying comments for a video with support for posting new comments, @mention autocomplete, and relative timestamps.
frontend/src/components/EditProfileModal: Modal form for editing a user's profile, allowing username, bio, and avatar image updates, with preview and submission via the updateProfile mutation.
frontend/src/components/FollowButton.tsx: Button component that toggles following/unfollowing a user, showing loading state and requiring authentication before acting.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: App shell providing a fixed header with the RevReel logo and username, a bottom navigation bar with badge counts for DMs and notifications, and a profile setup modal for new users.
frontend/src/components/PostIssueModal.t: A modal dialog for authenticated users to post a car mechanical issue with a title, category, and description, using the useCreateMechanicsPost mutation and displaying toast notifications on success or failure.
frontend/src/components/PostListingModal: A modal dialog for creating a parts/car listing with fields for title, make, model, year, price, condition, category, and image URL, submitted via the useCreateListing mutation.
frontend/src/components/PostMeetModal.ts: A modal dialog for organizing a car meetup, collecting title, location, date/time, description, and category, then submitting via useCreateCarMeet with the date converted to nanosecond BigInt.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: A mandatory profile setup modal that collects a username, bio, and optional avatar image, then calls useCreateUser to create the user's profile on first login.
frontend/src/components/StartBuildLogMod: A modal dialog for starting a new car build log, collecting a title, car make/model/year, and description, submitted via the useCreateBuildLog mutation.
frontend/src/components/VideoCard.tsx: A TikTok-style video card component that handles video playback, likes, reactions, bookmarks, comments, and delete actions using ICP identity and backend query hooks.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A React hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider and useInternetIdentity hook for managing ICP Internet Identity authentication state, including login, logout, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes all React Query hooks (queries and mutations) for interacting with the ICP backend, covering users, videos, reactions, challenges, notifications, and more.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Barlow fonts, configures Tailwind, defines CSS custom properties for light/dark themes, and adds utility classes for neon effects and glassmorphism.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: An admin-only page that displays the current user's principal ID and provides a form to delete users by principal, with access control based on the isAdmin query.
frontend/src/pages/BuildLogDetails.tsx: Displays a single build log's details including car info, stages, and author, with owner-only controls to add stages or delete the log.
frontend/src/pages/BuildLogs.tsx: Lists all build logs in a card grid sorted by date, with a modal to start a new build log and navigation to individual log detail pages.
frontend/src/pages/CarMeetDetails.tsx: Shows full details for a single car meet including date, location, attendees, and join/leave actions with authentication checks.
frontend/src/pages/CarMeets.tsx: Displays a filterable, sortable list of car meets by category and upcoming/past date, with attend/leave actions and a modal to post new meets.
frontend/src/pages/Classifieds.tsx: Renders a grid of active classified listings with image, price, condition, and seller info, plus a modal to post new listings.
frontend/src/pages/Conversation.tsx: Renders a direct message conversation page between the current user and another user, supporting sending, deleting, and auto-marking messages as read with optimistic UI updates.
frontend/src/pages/Discover.tsx: Displays a discovery page with a debounced search bar that filters videos and users, plus browsable category and hashtag sections derived from all videos.
frontend/src/pages/Feed.tsx: Implements a vertically snapping video feed with 'For You' and 'Following' tabs, tracking the active video index and persisting mute state in sessionStorage.
frontend/src/pages/FilteredFeed.tsx: Shows a vertically snapping video feed filtered by either category or hashtag, with a header overlay displaying the filter label and video count.
frontend/src/pages/Inbox.tsx: Renders the messaging inbox listing all conversations sorted by recency, showing each conversation's avatar, username, message preview, and unread count badge.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Landing page for RevReel that displays a hero section with login via Internet Identity, redirecting authenticated users to the feed. Shows feature highlights (videos, car meets, mechanics help, build logs, leaderboards, classifieds).
frontend/src/pages/Leaderboard.tsx: Leaderboard page displaying top trending videos ranked by likes and top uploaders ranked by total likes across all their videos. Uses skeleton loaders while fetching data and renders rank cards for each entry.
frontend/src/pages/ListingDetails.tsx: Detail view for a single classifieds listing, showing image, price, condition, vehicle info, and seller profile. Allows the listing owner to deactivate/remove the listing.
frontend/src/pages/MechanicsHelp.tsx: Mechanics help forum page listing all community mechanic posts with category badges, comment counts, and timestamps. Authenticated users can open a modal to post a new issue.
Detail page for a single mechanics help post, showing the full description, category, author info, and threaded comments. Authenticated users can add comments, and the post author can delete the post.
frontend/src/pages/Notifications.tsx: Renders a notifications page with typed icons per notification category, relative timestamps, and a 'Mark all read' action, wrapped in an AuthGuard.
frontend/src/pages/Profile.tsx: Displays a user profile page with avatar upload, badges, stats, and tabbed sections for videos, saved content, and settings, supporting both own and other users' profiles.
frontend/src/pages/Upload.tsx: Provides a video upload form with file selection, thumbnail, hashtags, category picker, and progress tracking, submitting to the backend via the useUploadVideo hook.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module for reading, persisting, and clearing URL query parameters from both regular and hash-based routes, using sessionStorage for cross-navigation persistence.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom OKLCH color tokens, neon box shadows, Barlow font families, and animation keyframes for the RevReel dark theme.
project_state.json: Tracks RevReel project state including existing features, known issues, architectural notes, and a pending feature request to add a public landing page with an authentication entry point.
